newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 3.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Company under takeover offer from Koninklijke PTT Nederland (KPN) at A$2.45 a share.

Snyder Oil Corp said on Wednesday it expects to report a pre-tax gain of US$60 million upon closing of Cairn Energy Plc's merger with Command Petroleum Holdings NL. Snyder holds 32.6 percent, or 105 million shares, in Command and its SOCO Australia unit has granted approval for Cairn to acquire 19.9 percent of Command shares.

James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it sees Japan as the second most attractive market after the United States to sell its fibre cement product. James Hardie earlier said it expected lower profits for the six months to September 30, and the full 1996/97 year.
Foster's Brewing Group Ltd, on Wednesday painted a robust picture in its annual report for the future of its domestic wine and beer units while pledging improvement from offshore divisions.
